parallel.requirements: The prompt required eight slugs: matrix_math, point_fix, quaternion_math, quaternion_system, replay_io, replay_runner_fix, sim_world, and vector3_math, plus output artifacts and deterministic replay checks.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: No task plan or ownership assignment was executed. Parallel mode was enabled in configuration, but the run produced zero spawn calls, zero child thread ids, and zero child activity events before failure.
parallel.implementation: No implementation occurred. The task trajectory consists of a thread start, turn start, three reconnect notices, a stream-disconnect error, and turn.failed; patch snapshots stayed empty.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No code was integrated, no requirement patch files were produced, and final.txt was empty, so no deliverable was handed off.
parallel.verification: Regression observation history records zero diff lines and no triggered checks, and the official harness later marked the task unresolved.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: All eight requirements remained incomplete; the failure was an agent startup/transport failure rather than a task implementation attempt.

serial.requirements: The serial run read all eight requirement files and located the relevant MonoGame engine math files, game project files, replay inputs, expected hash, and helper scripts.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned the end-to-end workflow with a todo list for restoring engine math, implementing game replay logic, creating all requirement patch artifacts, building, testing, and producing replay outputs.
serial.implementation: The serial run committed patches for point_fix, vector3_math, quaternion_math, matrix_math, replay_io, replay_runner_fix, quaternion_system, and sim_world, then continued experimenting with quaternion/matrix behavior after local hash mismatch.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It built MonoGame DesktopGL and the headless game, produced output artifacts sufficient for six official tests, and copied requirement patches, but its final agent response was empty after a disconnect.
serial.verification: It ran local regression snapshots and official post-test checks; the final pane shows required outputs, engine tests, engine log, hash-file shape, event stream, and trace checks passed, while the hidden reference final-state hash failed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The remaining concrete defect was replay final-state mismatch: reported run hash b81c0149... did not equal the hidden reference 624c1633..., and the final todo state still marked build/check/replay artifact closure as incomplete after a disconnect.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The prompt required eight requirement slugs across engine math, game replay, artifacts, determinism, and per-requirement git patches, but the parallel run failed before reading or acting on them.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control enumerated the same eight requirement files and read their contents before implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial recognized and began covering the required task surface; parallel never progressed beyond startup failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel mode was enabled, but no child agents, subagent paths, or implementation owner actions appeared before the stream failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept one owner and used a todo list spanning engine math, game implementation, patch artifacts, build, tests, and replay outputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no actual parallel decomposition to compare; the serial control had a coherent single-owner work plan.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No parent-child context boundary was created; the only observed coordination facts are zero spawns and no child activity.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial inspected requirement files, game source, engine math files, replay assets, and helper scripts in one context before editing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The difference is not a cross-agent context transfer problem; serial accumulated local context while parallel failed before context use.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote no files; its patch timeline is empty at every sampled point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial committed implementations for point, vector, quaternion, matrix, replay I/O, replay runner, quaternion system, and simulation world.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced a substantial implementation while parallel produced no code changes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results or implementation results to retrieve; the run ended on a failed turn after stream disconnects.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt iterated locally, used command outputs, and then ended after a final file change with no final response due to stream disconnect.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no result lifecycle; serial had local intermediate results but did not close cleanly after its last edit.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created no task modifications, so there were no shared-state collisions, merges, or deliverable overwrites.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced per-requirement commits and patch artifacts for all eight slugs in one workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The relevant distinction is absence of parallel writes versus serial staged integration, not a concurrent-write race.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel triggered no regression checks because there were no diff lines; official post-agent tests immediately failed the unchanged workspace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran focused checks and produced output artifacts that passed six official output checks, failing only the reference final-state SHA comparison.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached meaningful verification and acceptance evidence; parallel had none beyond empty no-change observations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed only a few seconds before an agent transport failure, leaving all eight requirements incomplete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent roughly nineteen minutes of agent time, then failed on stream disconnect with build, checks, replay reruns, and artifact completion still marked incomplete in its todo state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed, but parallel was an early startup failure while serial made substantial progress and then closed with unfinished acceptance work and a hidden-reference hash mismatch.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail, not discordant: current completed status.json evaluations mark both solution_passed=false. The task-solving difference is nevertheless large. Parallel failed before task execution due to stream disconnection, with no child execution, no edits, no patches, no tests, and no output. Serial performed a substantive single-agent implementation, produced all eight requirement patch artifacts, built and generated replay outputs, and passed six of seven visible output checks; it failed because its deterministic final-state hash did not match the hidden reference, with the harness also recording an official test-timeout warning.
parallel_contributors: Agent stream disconnected before any task work, leaving all requirements and outputs untouched.
serial_contributors: Single-agent implementation covered all eight requirement slugs and reached post-test execution, but generated a non-reference final replay hash.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial likely retained an ordinary game/math behavior defect after implementation, evidenced by the hidden-reference hash mismatch despite other output checks passing; this is not a parallel coordination pattern.
evaluator_effects: Status evaluation exposes no testcase counts because final_test_results is null; the pane records six passed output checks, one failed hash check, and the harness warning that tests timed out after 1200 seconds.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both failed officially, with process contrast but no retained parallel coordination pattern
